title: Multiplexed RNAscope Imaging of mRNAs in Drosophila Brains
author: Wu, Lambatan, et al.

steps.title: Dissect and fix brains
steps.instruction: Collect adult Drosophila brains of matched age and sex, dissect them, fix in 4 % formaldehyde/PBS, dehydrate (Day 2), and store in 100 % methanol at –20 °C for up to 6 months.

substeps.instruction: Dissect adult Drosophila brains of matched age/sex.
Fix brains in 4 % formaldehyde prepared in PBS.
Dehydrate according to the Day 2 protocol.
Store brains in 100 % methanol at –20 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Optional 3D deconvolution
steps.instruction: If desired, deconvolve image stacks using a theoretical point‑spread function in Nikon NIS Elements (or equivalent software), controlling iteration number to avoid ringing or noise artifacts.

substeps.instruction: Load image stacks into Nikon NIS Elements (or Huygens, Imaris ClearView, Fiji/ImageJ).
Apply a theoretical PSF calculated from wavelength, numerical aperture, and refractive index.
Run deconvolution, monitoring the number of iterations to prevent artifacts.

steps.title: Generate and train binary segmentation
steps.instruction: Create ground‑truth binary masks of IHC‑labeled cells, train NIS.ai segment AI with them, and apply the trained model to batch images, editing any errors manually.

substeps.instruction: Manually delineate each IHC‑labeled cell using the NIS Elements Binary Toolbar and Binary Editor to produce a ground‑truth binary mask.
Train NIS.ai ‘segment ai’ with the ground‑truth (≥1000 training iterations) until training loss reaches ≈0.02.
Apply the trained AI to subsequent image files and manually edit the resulting binary masks for accuracy.

steps.title: Apply DOG filter for puncta detection
steps.instruction: Detect transcript puncta by applying a Difference of Gaussian (DOG) filter and Bright Spot detection with uniform parameters across samples, using a spot size of 1 pixel.

substeps.instruction: Apply the DOG filter (two Gaussian blurs with different sigma values) to each fluorescence channel.
Set Bright Spot detection parameters: typical diameter, contrast, intensity; set spot size to 1 pixel/spot.
Optionally increase digital spot size for visual verification, then revert to 1 pixel before final counting.

steps.title: Quantify puncta per cell
steps.instruction: Aggregate detected bright spots within each 3D binary object, exclude border‑touching spots, and record puncta counts per cell for each probe.

substeps.instruction: Group detected spots within each 3D binary object (cell).
Exclude spots that intersect the binary object border.
Record the number of puncta per cell for each RNAscope probe.

description: The protocol below is based on the notion that RNAscope is sufficiently sensitive to detect individual molecules of mRNA in fixed cells (Xie et al.2). Our protocol has been modified from the technical notes provided with ACDBio’s Multiplex Fluorescent Detection Kit v2 and from work done in zebrafish embryos (Gross-Thebing et al.3). It has been adapted for whole mount staining of adult Drosophila brains and combined with immunostaining of genetically labeled cell populations using Gal4/UAS expression of a hemagglutinin-tagged GFP marker (De et al.1).
